notes: Reviewable CoMaps leaf display-name overrides for the country-grouped UI. CoMaps still uses pre-reform names in countries.txt / borders; clients show display_name when overridden.

Norway_Hedmark.note: Norwegian county reform 2020: Hedmark + Oppland merged into Innlandet. CoMaps still ships separate Hedmark/Oppland MWMs.

Norway_Oppland.note: Norwegian county reform 2020: Hedmark + Oppland merged into Innlandet. CoMaps still ships separate Hedmark/Oppland MWMs.

Norway_Hordaland.note: Norwegian county reform 2020: Hordaland merged into Vestland (with Sogn og Fjordane). CoMaps leaf id unchanged.

Norway_North Trondelag.note: Nord- and Sør-Trøndelag merged into Trøndelag (2018). CoMaps still ships separate leaves.

Norway_South Trondelag.note: Nord- and Sør-Trøndelag merged into Trøndelag (2018). CoMaps still ships separate leaves.

likely_outdated_elsewhere.note: CoMaps may still use pre-2016 région names in leaf/group labels; review against current INSEE régions before adding overrides.
Ceremonial vs ceremonial/admin county naming drifts; review English ceremonial counties and Welsh/Scottish council areas before overrides.
Some Regierungsbezirk / Kreis groupings may lag Land reforms; review before overrides.
Voivodeship leaf labels may not match the latest GUS naming; review before overrides.
State and UT splits (e.g. Jammu and Kashmir / Ladakh) may lag in CoMaps borders; review before overrides.
